statement: write-containment.ts exports 23 symbols in total: 8 functions, 2 numeric constants, 1 diagnostics object, 12 type exports; there is no export default and no bare export { } re-export.

drainGitContentionWarnings (write-containment.ts:312) returns and clears the list of git calls that exhausted their index.lock retry budget, reporting a fail-open degradation once per drain; its declared return type GitContentionWarning (:295) is itself not exported.
classifyViolation (write-containment.ts:511) maps a two-character git porcelain XY status to ContainmentViolationKind: ?? to untracked, D/A/M first-match to deleted/added/modified, else other.

snapshotOutOfScopeDirtyPaths (write-containment.ts:772) captures the pre-dispatch baseline of dirty paths outside artifactDir with a blob hash each and, when captureContentDir is set, a copy of their bytes under <captureContentDir>/containment/baseline/<repo-relative-path>; returns [] when git, the worktree, or the artifact scope is unavailable.

detectNewOutOfScopeViolations (write-containment.ts:814) computes current out-of-scope dirtiness minus the pre-dispatch baseline, re-hashing baseline paths so a same-path overwrite in a later iteration is still detected; it throws when artifactDir lies outside a resolvable worktree while its snapshot sibling returns [] for the unusable-git case.

quarantineViolations (write-containment.ts:1065) records each guarded path under <artifactDir>/containment/quarantine/ as manifest.json plus content/ bytes, patch-head/ diff against HEAD and patch-baseline/ diff against pre-dispatch bytes, never throwing and keeping the first per-path failure.

revertOutOfScopeViolations (write-containment.ts:1146) applies 'preserve' (default) or opt-in 'restore' per violating path and never deletes: in-HEAD paths restore from HEAD or from captured baseline bytes (preserved when neither is usable), not-in-HEAD paths are always preserved.

buildContainmentViolationEvent (write-containment.ts:1214) assembles the containment_violation JSONL payload including the reverted actions and a dataLossPossible block naming every path rolled back to HEAD plus where its bytes survive.

enforceWriteContainment (write-containment.ts:1267) is the composing post-dispatch guard: detect, capture the revert patch, quarantine, revert, optionally append the event, then partition the result into fatal violations and non-fatal advisories with recoveryHint and quarantinePath.

30 top-level functions are module-private; __internals (:1382) exposes only 8 of them, and partition logic inside enforceWriteContainment (escapesArtifactTree, isPacketScopedPath, isPreservedAdvisory) is not reachable from tests at all.
